publication_scope: one fixed-seed local LRU direct-repair turnaround contrast against accepted E05

parent.accepted_behavior: three local LRU repair/restock/issue cycles, without backorders

source.rule: ItemRepair.DIRPT is direct repair turnaround in hours without a subtask override; SystemResults NSYRY/NSYUA are time-averaged system states, StockTotalResults NBO/PNB are time-averaged backorder states, NDF is a demand count, and ROS/WT/WTS are demand-time shortage and wait measures.

hypothesis_not_guarantee: With the accepted parent's first removed-item repair starting near hour 9.92193 and second demand near hour 22, a thirteen-hour direct repair may leave no stock at that demand. Failure timing and any later demand must be read from this child's native event log, not copied from the parent.
physical_identity_observability: The accepted E05 native log issues stock item ID0 and records its fit task completion, but the next critical failed installed item is ID2; no intervening log event maps ID0 to installed ID2. The CLI report contains aggregate SystemResults and StockTotalResults, not an installed physical-item map. This bounded contract verifies critical-failure ID through arriving-system failure, demand, removal and DIRP repair, and replacement stock ID through issue/receipt and fit task. It does not assert cross-fit installed physical ID continuity or terminal installed physical ID; those remain unverified. The terminal fit receipt ID and system-ready state are separately reported.

report_gate.command: SIMLOX -jsonreport of the child SXO, with the accepted E05 default report settings; no new selector
report_gate.raw_format: Preserve exact raw report bytes; the installed writer's trailing commas are normalized only in a separate in-memory parser copy
report_gate.required_bins: 72 half-hour rows in each required table over [0,36)
report_gate.reconciliation: Require every child backorder to clear before hour 36. For each half-hour bin independently integrate ready, system-repair and backorder event intervals, check SystemResults NSYRY/NSYUA/NFAIL and state partitions, and check aggregate StockTotalResults NBO/PNB/NDF plus demand-bin ROS/WT/WTS. Physical item IDs, on-hand membership and every stock transition are proven from the complete event log, not inferred from aggregate StockTotalResults. Printed event-time comparisons use at most 0.001 hour and float32 bin fractions at most 0.003. Other report fields are outside this bounded acceptance.

native_gate: Before launch, independently verify parent publication, all 12 parent local raw seals, manual rule, only one authored source-cell delta, exact 20 row-containing table shape, frozen source hashes, unique run ID and no active owner.

Use one serial SSH session-0 run under Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue; require only the protected GUI PID 13340 in active session 1 with pinned start UTC 2026-09-28T10:09:56.8261381Z. Use a fresh run directory; do not rerun accepted parents or retry a failed directory.

Require exact import/export roundtrip of all 20 authored row-containing tables before calculation; converter Errors=0, interpreted warnings, valid nonempty SXO, full event log and the pinned default JSON report.

Trace each critical failed-item ID through the arriving-system failure, demand, removal, DIRP task/subtask and repair return. Trace each replacement stock ID through issue or backorder receipt, fit subtask and SURP completion. Verify the prior fit and receipt finish before a later failure, but do not infer an unlogged ID mapping from the replacement receipt to the next installed failed item. Report the terminal fit receipt ID, system-ready state and any pending repair without claiming an installed physical ID. Reconcile every event-log stock transition and all 72 half-hour SystemResults and StockTotalResults rows; do not call StockTotalResults an item-level stock ledger.

Accept a backorder contrast only if at least one child demand waits for a previously removed item's direct repair, with physical item identity and wait/fit times supported by the raw log and stock report. Otherwise preserve a failed diagnostic and do not publish the hypothesis as behavior.
Freeze invocation, raw and failure hashes; require a separately written independent read-only replay and bounded scope review before PR.
limits: One teaching LRU, base, seed, DIRPT=13 versus accepted DIRPT=1. Post-fit installed physical ID and cross-cycle ID continuity are not exposed by the CLI log and remain unverified. No general timing law, FIFO, remote supply, reorder, resource contention, GUI-only, cross-engine or full E05/Issue 18 claim. K01/K08 GUI observations stay blocked; I07 opening-stock-three stays excluded.
